units.source_text: 「如果你無心和我認真商量的話，那我也毫無辦法。」

en.t: If you have no intention of seriously discussing it with me, then there is nothing I can do.

units.source_text: 「商量什麼？」我真的沒有一點頭緒。

en.t: Discuss what? I truly had no idea at all.
It is whatever you have in mind.

units.source_text: 「比如說？」「還問我呢，你今後打算怎麼辦？」

en.t: For example? You are asking me? What do you intend to do from now on?
Do you mean I should go find a job?

units.source_text: 「不，我是問你自己心裡究竟是怎麼想的？」

en.t: No, I am asking what you yourself truly think inside.
But even if I wanted to go to school...

units.source_text: 「那也需要錢，但問題不在於錢，而在於你的想法。」

en.t: That would require money too, but the problem is not money; it is what you think.

units.source_text: 他為什麼不直截了當地說「老家寄錢過來」呢？

en.t: Why did he not simply say, The money will be sent from home?

units.source_text: 只要有這麼一句話，我就會立刻拿定主意去上學。

en.t: With just that one sentence, I would immediately have made up my mind to go to school.

units.source_text: 他的話總是讓我墜入五里霧中。

en.t: His words always left me completely lost in a fog.
